description: Lite suite: one case per documentation tool added in v0.3.0 (search_documentation, get_documentation, get_api_parameters, list_documentation_topics).

cases.title: Search docs for truck weight restrictions in Directions API
cases.name: search_documentation
cases.description: Keyword search of the bundled docs index, boosted to the Directions API
cases.prompt: Search the NextBillion.ai documentation for 'truck weight restrictions' in the Directions API.
cases.passCriteria: Calls search_documentation (query/api wording is model-chosen, so not asserted)

cases.title: Fetch the Avoid Tolls & Highways example page
cases.name: get_documentation
cases.description: Retrieve a full docs page by doc_id (as returned by search_documentation)
cases.prompt: Open the documentation page with doc_id 'routing/directions-api/examples/avoid-tolls-and-highways'.
cases.passCriteria: Calls get_documentation with the given doc_id

cases.title: Look up the Directions truck_weight parameter
cases.name: get_api_parameters
cases.description: Structured parameter lookup for one named parameter of an endpoint
cases.prompt: What are the type, default, and allowed range of the 'truck_weight' parameter in the Directions API?
cases.passCriteria: Calls get_api_parameters with endpoint 'directions' and name 'truck_weight'

cases.title: List Routing documentation topics
cases.name: list_documentation_topics
cases.description: Browse the docs catalogue filtered to one category
cases.prompt: List the documentation topics available in the Routing category.
